title: TinyDirector stage direction request v1 (ADDITIVE: does not change any other schema)
description: Written by the director to shared/inbox/<request_id>.json to direct the lesson already on stage: move the camera to a part, ring it with a highlight, replace the subtitle caption, or show a large measurement callout. Display only: no lesson value changes, nothing is built. The worker answers with a scene_result_v1 document (applied = 0) plus a 'direction' read-back block (blender_engine/direction.py).

focus.description: LED circuit: battery | resistor | led | current (the whole loop) | overview (the lesson camera's own framing); generated lesson: a part id, or overview

highlight.description: ring the focused part with a glowing halo

caption.description: new text for the circuit lesson's subtitle caption

callout.description: large measurement text shown with the focus (e.g. '21.2 mA' + a short note); values come from the calculation module; null removes it. Sending a focus without a callout removes the previous one.
